_comment: Edit this file to update your Work Experience timeline — no code needed. Add a new job by copying one of the blocks below (keep the commas between entries). Fields: 'period' is the date range shown, 'title' is the role/company line, 'desc' is the one-line description, 'icon' picks the little icon (one of: case, video, pen, star), 'current' (true/false) highlights it as your current role with the accent border. Save the file and refresh the page to see the change.
